snippet.title: The Funskin Project | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
The Funskin Project is an isometric survival horror game that takes players deep into the mysterious castle of Baron Fettuccini after a devastating blizzard forces them to seek shelter. Once inside, explore the castle and unravel its secrets while searching for a way out. Resources are scarce, and even time can work against you. [steam wishlist -  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3232650/The_Funskin_Project/]---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
